接入第一个工作负载，走通预测与推荐流程。
en: Quick start
Connect a workload and follow your first recommendation.

zh: 安装与部署
准备管理平台、任务引擎与执行组件，了解配置和启动方式。
en: Installation
Prepare the platform, job engine, and optional execution components.

zh: 功能架构与核心概念
理解工作负载模块、指标模板、算法与执行策略之间的关系。
en: Capabilities and concepts
Understand modules, metric templates, models, and operating policies.

zh: 指标接入与数据质量
配置数据源、指标模板和数据集，为预测准备可信输入。
en: Metrics and data quality
Connect sources, templates, and datasets to prepare dependable inputs.

zh: 算法与模型管理

en: Models and prediction modes
Choose fixed or dynamic methods, explore models, corrections, and eligibility.

zh: 回测与效果评估
比较资源预测与实际用量，理解准确度、误差和算法排名。
en: Backtesting and evaluation
Compare resource forecasts with actual use and understand scores and rankings.

zh: 资源推荐与前瞻决策
理解多算法共识、提前量和各项约束如何形成最终建议。
en: Recommendations and look-ahead
Learn how model consensus, lead time, and constraints shape resource advice.

分别开放新 Pod 资源配置与副本调整，追踪实际执行结果。
en: Admission and scaling
Enable Pod resource advice and replica scaling separately, then review outcomes.

zh: 安全边界与故障回退
配置固定周期、兜底、旁路和保护策略，控制自动行为。
en: Safety and fallback
Manage schedules, fallback, bypass, and safeguards for automatic actions.

zh: 监控与问题排查
从数据源、算法运行到实际副本，定位流程中的异常。
en: Monitoring and troubleshooting
Trace issues from data sources and model runs to actual replica readiness.

zh: 平台管理
维护权限、任务、审计和时区，支持日常运行与复盘。
en: Administration
Manage access, scheduled tasks, audit, and time settings.

zh: 常见问题
查找接入、算法选择、执行模式和资源更新的常见答案。
en: Common questions
Find answers about setup, model choice, operating modes, and resource updates.

zh: Naive · 持续值
将最后一个观测值延续到整个预测范围，作为所有候选的基本对照。适合检查数据与预测链路，不能提前识别周期或突增。
en: Naive
Repeats the latest observation across the horizon. Use it as a basic comparison and to check the data workflow; it cannot anticipate cycles or sudden changes.

zh: Seasonal Naive · 季节持续
重复前一个周期对应位置的值，用于规律重复的负载，也是周期模型的比较基线。前一周期的异常会被重复。
en: Seasonal Naive
Repeats the corresponding observations from the preceding cycle. A seasonal baseline for repeating demand; anomalies in that cycle are repeated too.

zh: EWMA · 指数平滑
平滑近期波动后将水平延续到未来。适合作为低成本、重视近期负载的候选，不会直接外推日周期。
en: EWMA
Smooths recent observations and projects the resulting level. A low-cost candidate for recent demand, without explicit daily seasonality.

zh: Histogram Percentile · 历史分位数
对带时间衰减的历史取百分位，并将该值作为未来各步的水平。适合关注资源高水位的规格比较，不刻画峰值发生的具体时刻。
en: Histogram Percentile
Uses a time-decayed historical percentile as a constant future level. Useful for comparing high-water resource sizing, without predicting when a peak occurs.

zh: Random Forest · 随机森林
对抽样后的历史特征训练多棵回归树并平均，支持非线性关系与协变量。训练成本高于简单统计方法。
en: Random Forest
Fits and averages regression trees on sampled historical features, supporting nonlinear relationships and covariates. More costly than simple statistical methods.

zh: KNN · 历史相似窗口
寻找与当前窗口相似的历史片段，参考其后续轨迹。适合历史中曾出现过的峰谷形态，不擅长没有历史先例的新变化。
en: KNN
Finds similar historical windows and follows their subsequent trajectories. Useful for recurring shapes, with limited ability to anticipate patterns absent from history.

zh: Holt-Winters · 趋势与季节
分离水平、趋势和季节变化。支持加性或乘性季节，以及阻尼趋势，适合有周期且水平缓慢变化的负载。
en: Holt-Winters
Models level, trend, and seasonality with additive or multiplicative seasons and optional damped trend. Suitable for cyclic demand with changing levels.

zh: 模型服务 · 预测与微调
通过 HTTP 调用外部时序模型。模型管理中配置服务，模块中选择预测方式。服务不可用时本次候选失败，其他算法继续按资格参与。
en: Model service · forecasting and tuning
Calls an external time-series model over HTTP. Configure it in Model management, then choose the module prediction mode. A failed request fails that candidate while other eligible methods continue.

zh: Theta · 平滑与漂移
将平滑水平与线性趋势斜率的一半结合，支持先去季节。适合作为带噪声趋势序列的候选，预测下限为 0。
en: Theta
Combines a smoothed level with half the fitted linear slope, optionally removing seasonality first. A candidate for noisy trends; forecasts are clamped at zero.

zh: MSTL · 多重季节分解
同时分离日、周季节形状，对去季节后的序列使用 Theta。本项目采用固定季节形状的迭代分解，不是随时间变化的 LOESS 分解。
en: MSTL
Separates daily and weekly seasonal shapes and applies Theta to the remainder. This implementation iterates fixed seasonal shapes rather than time-varying LOESS components.

zh: Seasonal Profile · 周期画像
按一天中的时段和周几分桶，对每个桶取衰减百分位。适合“工作日上午忙、周末安静”等有时钟规律的负载。
en: Seasonal Profile
Groups observations by time of day and optionally weekday, then uses a decayed percentile per bucket. Useful for weekday/weekend demand patterns.

zh: Peak Envelope · 峰值包络
先计算滚动最大值包络，再用稳健斜率外推，关注高水位而非平均值。适合内存锯齿、缓存增长等形态。
en: Peak Envelope
Builds a rolling-maximum envelope and extrapolates its robust slope. Targets high-water demand rather than averages, such as memory sawtooth patterns and cache growth.

zh: Combination · 组合预测
对多个成员的预测逐步取中位数，或按近期误差加权。组合本身也需要回测晋升，不默认优于单个成员。
en: Combination
Combines member forecasts using a stepwise median or recent-error weights. The combination must earn backtest promotion like other candidates.

zh: Ridge AR · 岭回归自回归
用滞后值、可选 UTC 日历特征与协变量拟合线性关系。适合稳定的线性依赖，作为低成本机器学习候选。
en: Ridge AR
Fits linear relationships from lags, optional UTC calendar features, and covariates. A relatively inexpensive machine-learning candidate for stable linear dependencies.

zh: GBDT · 梯度提升树
逐棵拟合残差，学习滞后、日历与协变量的非线性关系。可预测均值附近的点值，也可直接训练分位数目标。
en: GBDT
Fits successive trees to residuals using lags, calendars, and covariates. Supports squared-error point forecasts or a native quantile objective.

zh: AI 助手与 Skill
查询平台状态、使用斜杠技能，导出报告并解读资源变化。
en: AI assistant and skills
Query platform state, use slash commands, export reports, and explain changes.

zh: LLM 连接配置
设置默认与指定模型、工具调用、高级参数和凭据。
en: LLM configuration
Configure default and selected models, tools, advanced settings, and credentials.

zh: AI 定时任务与邮件
按计划查询平台，把模型回答保存并通过邮件发送。
en: AI scheduled tasks and email
Ask on a schedule, retain answers, and deliver them by email.

zh: 首页与运行概览
查看模块状态、需要关注的模块和实际扩缩容活动。
en: Dashboard and activity
Review module status, attention flags, and applied scaling activity.

zh: 系统架构
从系统总览、功能模块和两条执行路径理解平台。
en: System architecture
Explore the overview, module responsibilities, and execution paths.

zh: 运行逻辑与反馈循环
理解采集、预测、推荐、按需刷新和实际结果如何协同。
en: Runtime and feedback loops
Understand collection, forecasts, advice, refresh, and actual outcomes.
